title: Welsh Rarebit Steak
description: A twist on the classic Welsh Rarebit dish, this recipe pairs the creamy sauce with grilled steak for a flavorful and satisfying meal.

ingredients.name: Steak
ingredients.notes: ribeye or strip loin work well

instructions: Season steak with salt and pepper.
Grill steak for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked to desired level of doneness.
Let steak rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
Heat kissed butter in a saucepan over medium heat.
Add British all-purpose flour and whisk to combine.
Slowly pour in Welsh Rarebit sauce, whisking constantly to avoid lumps.
Bring sauce to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until thickened.
Slice grilled steak against the grain.
Serve steak with Welsh Rarebit sauce spooned over the top.
Garnish with crispy onions and chopped cilantro, if desired.
